items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: And we had Joe Attles who was the understudy for Sportin' Life

ctx.x: I have two questions before we go ahead to Nazarro calling you back. One is, who are some of the other people that played in "Porgy and Bess?"
We had Todd Duncan, he was Porgy. And Ann Wiggins Brown

was Bess. Seren Robins was Crown's wife and Maria was just a -- took care like a mother around -- and then we had Mr. Johnson -- what's his first name? Johnson was the lawyer. And we had Joe Attles who was the understudy for Sportin' Life and -- I can't think of all -- Elton Warren was the sweetheart of somebody, I forgot who that was.
